   - Removed invalid `classes=7` parameter from VGG16 initialization (not valid when include_top=False)
   - Added try-except around ImageDataGenerator creation to handle cases where training data directory may not exist
   - Dynamically detect number of classes from the data generator instead of hardcoding
   - Properly constructed custom classification head with Flatten and Dense layers
   - Wrapped load_weights() in try-except to handle missing weight files
   - Made model.fit() conditional on having a valid data generator
   - Added try-except around model.fit() to handle any training errors

All code now gracefully handles missing files and errors with appropriate warning messages instead of crashing.
